findings.title: CISA DROPS THREE FRESH EXPLOITED BUGS WITH A 72-HOUR DEADLINE
findings.comment: FreeSWITCH, GPUStack and OpenSSH all landed in the catalog on a quiet Sunday with remedies due Wednesday — CISA hands feds a three-day patch clock, so batten those hatches today, not after yer coffee.

findings.title: GPUSTACK AUTH BYPASS YIELDS ADMIN ON AI GPU CLUSTERS
findings.comment: Yer shiny AI GPU fleet hands admin to any scallywag who whispers "127.0.0.1" via a spoofed header — flip force_auth_localhost to true, strip X-GPUStack-Real-IP at the proxy, or watch yer cloud keys sail off on a rented AWS sloop.

findings.title: SONICWALL SSLVPN SAML MFA BYPASS, NO WORKAROUND
findings.comment: A second login route quietly steps around yer SAML-enforced MFA like a drunk guard waving drunks past — no workaround exists, so patch Gen7 and Gen8 firmware before ransomware crews chart this well-worn VPN course.

findings.title: GITLAB CVSS 10 CI LINT RCE TAKES 225 SHOTS IN FIVE DAYS
findings.comment: Two hundred twenty-five unauthenticated cannon blasts at self-managed GitLabs Nov 4-8 with no confirmed prize yet — patch to 19.4.2 and mind the Ruby hiding under the deck, or yer pipeline secrets feed the fish.

findings.title: ARES OPEN-CORE RED TEAM PLATFORM MAPS PATHS TO DOMAIN ADMIN
findings.comment: A free red-team galleon with 66 modules mapped to ATT&CK and graded by OPSEC noise — grand for yer purple crew, less grand knowing every script kiddie can download the same cannons by suppertime.

findings.title: N0N RANSOMWARE SPREE LISTS EXPEDIA, STAPLES, HALLMARK
findings.comment: N0n dumped Staples, Expedia, Hallmark and a whole fleet of biopharma names this week, 281 victims total, yet offers not a doubloon of proof for the big prizes. Bold as a broadside, thin as the last rum ration.

findings.title: STORM-3358 WIELDS ARTEX AI AGAINST BANKS
findings.comment: Cambodia-based Storm-3358 turned the ARTEX agentic framework loose on Southeast Asian finance since October, letting robot deckhands run the boarding party. Even the pirates have automated the galley now.

findings.title: COZY BEAR POISONS WEB ANALYTICS IN WATERING HOLE CAMPAIGN
findings.comment: SVR-linked APT29 hijacked the Plerdy analytics script to serve n-day exploit chains at thousands of phones, mostly Ukrainian, slurping Telegram, Keychain and WhatsApp booty. Old bear, new tricks, same thieving paws.

findings.title: BITTER APT SPEARPHISHS SOUTH ASIA WITH PAPRAT
findings.comment: BITTER APT lobbed diplomatic and military lures at government, energy and engineering targets across South Asia to deliver PapRAT spyware, per Fortinet. A seasoned privateer still sailing the same tired waters.

findings.title: OPERATION SNOWBALL: AUTONOMOUS AI INTRUSIONS HIT EUROPEAN TELECOM
findings.comment: Malbear Labs found a DeepSeek Flash-powered autonomous harness prowling a European telecom and 13 hosted orgs via Cisco BroadWorks XSP for two weeks. No flag, no face, just a ghost crew with a very long prompt.

findings.title: SOUL RANSOMWARE DEBUTS WITH 25 VICTIMS IN A DAY
findings.comment: New crew Soul posted its first leak-site prizes on Nov 4 and racked up 25 victims on day one, while N0n led the week with 45 claims across 36 countries. Fresh keel, same extortion cargo.

findings.title: SLIPPYNUNCHUCKS ABUSES SOGOU UPDATES FOR DARKVIGIL
findings.comment: China-aligned SlippyNunchucks hijacked Sogou input-method updates through DNS trickery to drop DarkVigil malware. Poisoning the very keyboards folk type their pleas for help on. Devilish tidy work.

findings.title: SSHOLE EXPLOIT SCANS HIT HONEYPOTS
findings.comment: Arrr, attackers need only a comically long password; Alpine’s tiny attack surface apparently included a gangplank.

findings.title: SONICWALL MFA BYPASS JOINS KEV
findings.comment: Arrr, valid alternate credentials can sidestep SAML-enforced MFA, because two locks are useless when one door ignores both.

findings.title: BARRACUDA ROOT CHAIN ENTERS NUCLEI
findings.comment: Arrr, the pre-auth ESG chain now has a public Nuclei template; mass probing be industrialised before confirmed attacks even arrive.

findings.title: LINUX ZERO-COPY BUG ENABLES ROOT
findings.comment: Arrr, a low-privileged user can overwrite cached read-only files through packet processing; “read-only” was merely a polite suggestion.
